about:
AOS (AI Operating Standard): making AI autonomy checkable, not rhetorical.

We care less about “alignment vibes” and more about hooks, CI, and logs you can point to in a URL.

Spec: https://github.com/aos-standard/AOS-spec Notes: https://dev.to/aos_standard

Validating the pipeline on a private monorepo (CI + audits). Human operator.
